name: web-terminal
title: Web Terminal
description: A full terminal on this server in a browser tab: the same shell as ssh, with colours, full-screen programs (htop, vim, tmux) and copy and paste. It is reached through its HTTPS route only, always behind Authelia's sign-in, so port 22 no longer has to be open on your router. DCS makes a key for it that works from this server's own containers only; switching it off removes the key. Needs Traefik with a domain and Authelia.
auth_note: The web terminal is a shell on this server: its route is always behind Authelia, and it cannot be deployed without it.
